name: BlackGrowlmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] Both players trash the top 2 cards of their decks. Then, you may return 1 [Guilmon] or 1 card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name from your trash to your hand.
source_effect: [On Deletion] You may return 1 [Guilmon] or 1 card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name from your trash to your hand.
